correctness.rationale: For 5-regular Clebsch Cayley(F2^4,{1,2,4,8,15}), 16 distinct 5-element neighborhoods generate exactly 353 faces including empty, face vector (16,80,160,80,16). Since every triangle belongs to exactly one maximal neighborhood, high boundary ranks are 64 and 16; 1-skeleton rank15 and independent modulo-two rank d2=65 force rational rank65 and only reduced H2 rank31. Independent enumeration of all 1920 A semidirect S5 transformations and signed oriented-face traces reproduced character distribution {-5:80,-1:825,1:944,3:60,7:10,31:1}, Fourier A-isotypic multiplicities {6:1,1:10,3:5} and full-average invariant 0. Source explicitly derives three little-group summands of dimensions 6+10+15 and matches induced character against direct chains for all 1920 elements. Does not claim a new nonequivariant wedge31 S2 or integral module.
